reason: The original implementation of the revert() method was logically flawed because it attempted to construct a new line using the same origin point and a point derived from subtracting the direction vector. This resulted in a line that was not correctly oriented or defined in the same coordinate space as the original. The patch correctly constructs the reverted line by using the origin and a point along the original direction, then explicitly negating the direction vector to ensure the line is properly reversed while maintaining the same geometric path.
